mood: Professional, Trustworthy, Modern SaaS, Oxford Academic but Tech-Forward

hierarchy.urdu_specific: For Urdu text, increase line-height using leading-loose or leading-[1.8] to accommodate Nastaliq ascenders/descenders.

typography.guidelines: Use 'Outfit' for English headings and 'Noto Nastaliq Urdu' for Urdu headings. Body text should use 'Inter' (English) or 'Noto Sans Arabic' (Urdu) for readability at small sizes. Ensure font-families are toggled based on the active language direction (dir='rtl' or 'ltr').

colors.guidelines: Avoid generic SaaS blue or purple. Rely on an organic 'Oxford/Emerald' palette for trust and educational authority. Avoid teal (#1B93A4) entirely. Use Amber for highlights, trials, and warnings.

layouts.global: Always use CSS logical properties (ms-*, me-*, ps-*, pe-*, start-*, end-*) instead of physical left/right properties to seamlessly support LTR (English) and RTL (Urdu). The root or layout wrapper must toggle dir='ltr' or dir='rtl'.

marketing.hero: Bento-style or wide asymmetrical grid. Use generous spacing (py-24, py-32).
marketing.features: Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with glassmorphism cards.
marketing.footer: Generous padding, large brand typography. MUST include developer branding: 'Developed by Zeeshan Computers Sheikh Fazal — 0343-0819382'.

dashboard.sidebar: Collapsible side navigation. Use 'start-0' and logical borders.
dashboard.grid: High density grid. Use gap-4 or gap-6. Dashboard cards should have a max border-radius of 8px (rounded-lg).
dashboard.cards: Flat solid background in dark mode, crisp 1px borders (border-border). In health/academic data, prioritize flat colors over glassmorphism for data clarity.
dashboard.tables: Clean, dense tables with sticky headers. Add specific hover states on rows.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly on marketing header/nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-slate-900/70). NOT to be used for dashboard data cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, layered shadows on light mode cards (shadow-sm). Use inner borders instead of shadows in dark mode.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using border-border. Cards should look crisp and structured.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for marketing, rounded-md for dashboard. MUST include hover and active states (e.g., hover:bg-emerald-800 hover:text-white).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI standard, rounded-md, ring-on-focus (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500).
components.charts: Recharts with responsive containers. Ensure tooltips use theme colors. Ensure colors are accessible.
components.icons: lucide-react. Use stroke-width 1.5 for a premium, lightweight feel. Remember to flip directional icons in RTL (rtl:-scale-x-100 or rtl:rotate-180).
components.toast: Use Sonner for all notifications (success, error, loading).
components.branding: Include 'Developed by Zeeshan Computers Sheikh Fazal — 0343-0819382' in Login footer, main app footer, About page, and Subscription page (subtle text-sm text-muted-foreground).

motion.hover: Transition transform and background-color (transition-colors duration-200, hover:-translate-y-0.5 on cards).
motion.page_load: Framer motion for staggered entrance of dashboard widgets and marketing sections.

marketing_hero.description: Two students collaborating on a laptop, perfect for LMS/Student portal hero.

school_building.description: Modern school building architecture, useful for marketing about page or super admin.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure complete RTL support using logical CSS classes (e.g., ps-4 instead of pl-4, ms-auto instead of ml-auto).
Implement language toggle (English/Urdu) that switches both text content and the HTML dir attribute.
Use 'Outfit' and 'Noto Nastaliq Urdu' fonts conditionally based on the active language.
Ensure 'Developed by Zeeshan Computers Sheikh Fazal — 0343-0819382' is present in required footers.
Dashboard must be responsive, showing a mobile hamburger menu on small screens and a persistent sidebar on desktop.
Never use `transparent` backgrounds for dropdowns or modals; always use a solid or glassmorphism background to ensure readability.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Provide loading skeletons for dashboard cards and tables.
Use Recharts for revenue/attendance charts and lucide-react for icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Avoid using emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided image_urls.
